messages:
From: Helen Park <h.park@silverpine.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@silverpine.io
Date: 2026-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request to be added to vendor master — Silverpine Labs

Hi Mina,

Hope you're well — I'm Helen, head of Ops at Silverpine Labs. We're starting work with Redwood on the observability integration (SOW signed last week) and need to get set up in your vendor master so Redwood finance can issue POs and process invoices.

Can you confirm the fields you need from us to create the vendor record (legal name, remit address, tax id, W9, invoice contact, PO email, preferred payment method)? I've attached a short onboarding questionnaire to kick things off.

We can return a completed W-9 and ACH form; for bank details we prefer to send them via a secure upload link — let me know if you have a vendor portal. Also: who at Redwood will be the PO originator (procurement or the engagement manager)? That affects the PO references we add to invoices.

Thanks — we'll get the paperwork back today if possible.

Regards,
Helen Park
Head of Operations
Silverpine Labs
[h.park@silverpine.io]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Helen Park <h.park@silverpine.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to be added to vendor master — Silverpine Labs

Hi Helen — welcome, and thanks for the questionnaire.

Short answers so we can keep this moving:
- Required for vendor master: legal entity name, W-9 (or W-8 if non-US), TAX ID (EIN/SSN as applicable), registered address, remit address, remit email for e-invoices, AP contact name/phone, invoice examples (PDF), and certificate of insurance if services > $50k/year.
- Payment methods supported: ACH (preferred), wire, or check. If sending ACH details, please use a secure file share (we will send a one-time upload link) — do not email full bank account numbers.
- PO creation: Procurement generates POs once the vendor is in the master. For this engagement, procurement (AP team) will issue POs and they will include the engagement code and contact name.

I've attached our Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form — please complete and return along with the signed W-9 and ACH form. I've looped in Laura (Proc Ops) to run the master-record creation and Markus (Finance) for payment routing.

Next steps: once we receive the documents we'll validate tax/identity, create a temporary vendor code for early POs, and confirm the official vendor ID in our system (please allow up to 2 business days after submission).

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Vendor Intake | Procurement
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Internal note — taking this on.

Checklist I'm going to follow (procurement intake):
1) Confirm legal name matches W-9 and business registry.
2) Capture remit address + remit email; set PO routing to procurement@redwood.com unless vendor requests a specific PO contact.
3) Upload documents to secure drive and flag for Finance review.
4) Verify COI requirement (services value).
5) Create temporary vendor code (VND-TEMP-####) for initial PO so SOW work can begin; assign permanent vendor ID after validation.

Markus — when you have a moment can you confirm: net terms default 30 days, will we allow 15 for Silverpine if they request? Also confirm the account code to attach to the integration SOW (EngOps: INTG-OBS-2026).

Linking the HubSpot onboarding ticket: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/HS-847506 — please add notes there after vendor ID is created.

Laura Bennett
Procurement Operations
laura_bennett@redwood.com
